VHP Navaratri entry call sparks 'Hindu Taliban' debate

A debate has emerged over the Vishva Hindu Parishad's (VHP) reported call to restrict Muslim participation in Navaratri and Garba events. The phrase 'Hindu Taliban' became central to the controversy following a discussion published by The Indian Express. OpIndia reported that Kuber demanded government intervention over the VHP's ban on Muslim entry into Navaratri events.
